summary: Server component (one instance, on a singleton-like entity) written by esv::interrupt::ZoneUpdateSystem (macOS) and read by esv::TimeSystem::ProcessTimeFactorRequests together with the ftb time-factor request singletons: entity -> time factor to apply while an interrupt is pending. Alive in idle levels, empty.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: bg3.exe creator 0x3594BB0 builds exactly the PreferencesRequest shape (0x40 bytes, HashSet + values) and uses the same destructor FUN_1405c4870 (raw free of values at +0x30 = trivial 4-byte or 8-byte values). EoCServer.dll+0x2B26D0 TimeSystem::ProcessTimeFactorRequests (whose view includes esv::interrupt::TimeFactorRequestsComponent const) copies maps of EntityHandle keys (stride 8 at +0x20) and 4-byte values (stride 4 at +0x30) into HashMap<EntityHandle,float>; the sibling ftb::TimeFactorRequestsSingletonComponent is HashMap<EntityHandle, float> in SE (Combat.h). Live: empty.

open_questions: The loop that reads exactly this component in ProcessTimeFactorRequests was not singled out (two map loops read singletons via FUN_1802b0a40/FUN_1802b0730); value could in theory be another 4-byte type.
